question: What is our total revenue across all time?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

question: List the regions whose revenue in Q4 2025 was lower than in Q3 2025.
sql: WITH q AS (SELECT c.region, CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END AS qtr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT q4.region FROM q q4 JOIN q q3 ON q3.region = q4.region AND q3.qtr = 3 WHERE q4.qtr = 4 AND q4.revenue < q3.revenue

question: Top 5 products by revenue in 2025
sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly revenue for 2025.
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many delivered or shipped orders were there in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: What is the cancellation rate for each payment method?
sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method

question: Which payment method has the highest cancellation rate?
sql: SELECT payment_method FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Average order value by channel in 2025
sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel

question: How many customers do we have in each region?
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY region

question: What was the gross margin by category in 2025?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND((SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 4) AS gross_margin FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category

question: Break down 2025 revenue by payment method.
sql: SELECT o.payment_method, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.payment_method

question: How many customers signed up in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Which 3 cities generate the most revenue?
sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was the average discount across all order lines placed in November 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS avg_discount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-12-01'

question: By what percentage did October-November revenue grow in 2025 compared with October-November 2024?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - 1, 4) AS growth FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND ((o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-12-01') OR (o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-12-01'))

question: How many active customers did we have in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Which category sold the most units in 2025?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Revenue by customer segment
sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.segment

question: How many customers have more than 10 delivered or shipped orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) t

question: How many orders were returned in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: On average, how many units are in a delivered or shipped order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

question: What was revenue in each quarter of 2025?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'MM') <= '03' THEN 'Q1' WHEN TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'MM') <= '06' THEN 'Q2' WHEN TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'MM') <= '09' THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which month of 2024 had the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much revenue came from Maharashtra in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND c.state = 'Maharashtra' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Which sub-category has made the most gross profit overall?
sql: SELECT p.sub_category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What share of all orders placed in 2025 were paid with UPI?
sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'UPI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS upi_share FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: What percentage of 2025 revenue came through the app?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'app' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 4) AS app_share FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: How many new customers signed up each month in 2025?
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(signup_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What was the average revenue per active customer in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
